purpose: 《我的修仙獎勵是不是發錯了？》第一季共用的 look、角色外貌（英文，給圖與影片模型）與聲音。每集 video.json 從這裡照抄用到的角色，不要各自改寫，避免換臉。中文外貌提示詞在 chapter-01.md 到 chapter-06.md 的人物表。
owner_notes: 畫風照《種田娶妻打天下》2026-10-16 晚站主的決定：3D 國漫 CG，不用真人；look.style 已寫成英文，定妝照提示詞照 refs-dh-jobs.json 的寫法。
美女規則照 chapter-01.md 的顏值規則：濃顏、合身剪裁、每集至少一個顏值鏡頭；不露、不濕身、鏡頭不停在身體部位。
說話的鏡頭一定會動嘴（種田 storyboard-rules.md）：台詞的 speaker 在畫面上時，data.motion 第一句寫他說這句話、嘴唇下巴隨每個音節動；說話鏡頭不用 still、不用 data.source；靜圖一集不超過 10%。
仙錄面板不由圖片或影片模型生成：拍江小滿的主觀鏡頭或臉部近景，面板文字在剪接時疊上（藍金色、像一頁書的半透明框，見每集 overlays.json）。prompt 裡不要寫面板、文字或 UI。
沈照雪受傷時（第 1–2 集）在該鏡 prompt 裡寫 her face gone translucent white、one sleeve torn and scorched at the cuff；好了之後不寫。
聲音是代理的建議，試片前照 voice-audition.md 試聽再定。
站主 2026-10-27：製作路線是 Colab 直接打 MiniMax API（image-01 首格、H3 v2 圖生影片），不走海螺網頁、不走站上伺服器；做法在 production/colab/README.md。

look.style: 3D Chinese donghua CG animation in the style of high-end domestic 3D animated series and game cinematics, Unreal Engine 5 cinematic render: semi-realistic stylised characters with refined features and slightly enlarged expressive eyes, detailed skin with texture but not photographic, individually rendered hair strands, cloth with physical weight, wear and dust; cool low-saturation palette with warm accents, volumetric light and thin haze, strong rim light, shallow depth of field, glamorous flattering beauty lighting on faces; not a photograph, not live action
look.negative: photograph, live action, real person, flat 2D anime, sketch, text, subtitles, watermark, logo, UI panel, extra fingers, deformed hands, blood, gore, wounds, nudity, cleavage, see-through clothing, bare back, wet clothes

system_panel: 藍金色、像翻開的一頁書的半透明框；獎勵落地時有金色光點散開；只在江小滿的主觀鏡頭裡出現。

characters.name: 江小滿
characters.appearance: East Asian young man of twenty-two, boyish good looks: thick brows, warm double-lidded eyes with a sly glint, straight nose, an easy crooked grin, lean build with forearms toned from tossing a wok, black hair tied in a messy topknot with a grey cloth strip, a faded ash-grey servant's short tunic with both sleeves rolled to the elbow, a rope belt with one wooden ladle tucked in it, straw sandals
